notes: Volume: Direccion del Registro Electoral, Eleccion Ordinaria Parlamentaria (Diputados), 4 de Marzo de 1973. Pages 7-142 hold one commune-level table per grouping (29 contests: 27 agrupaciones, the 7th split into Santiago 1st, 2nd and 3rd districts), with V (men), M (women) and T (total) columns; only the T column of the grouping-total column (headed TOTAL PROVINCIA / TOTAL nA. AGRUPACION / TOTAL ... DISTRITO) on the last page of each grouping was transcribed. Lists: in 1973 the parties ran in federations and the volume prints votes only per federation list (A.- Confederacion de la Democracia = CODE: PN, DC, DR, PIR, PADENA; B.- Partido de la Unidad Popular = UP: PS, PC, PR, MAPU, IC, API; C.- Union Socialista Popular = USOPO, a single party). No per-party subtotal is printed at grouping level, so each list here is a federation list with its printed TOTAL LISTA; 'unassigned' is the federation row's own figure (votes for the list without candidate preference). Per-party grouping totals could be obtained only by adding candidates by party, which would be a computed figure, so they are not given. Candidate 'party': for elected deputies it is the party printed in the list of deputies elected (pp.183-189); for the others it is the handwritten party annotation on the tables (not printed), abbreviated PN, DC, DR, PIR, PADENA, PDR, PS, PC, PR, MAPU, IC, API; null where none is legible (USOPO candidates). Seats per federation are from the table on p.192 (candidates-elected per grouping); elected candidates are the top preference-getters within each federation, and every one matches the printed list of elected deputies (pp.183-189, 150 deputies) and the '+' marks on the tables. Registered voters are not printed per grouping (only nationally). 'invalid' holds votos nulos. No 'valid' figure is printed (TOTAL GENERAL = cast). Grouping totals for every federation agree with the Tribunal Calificador summary on p.144, and the 29 contests add exactly to the national totals on p.193 (CODE 2.013.592, UP 1.605.170, USOPO 10.287, nulos 37.639, blancos 20.417, total 3.687.105). National: p.193 (inscritos 4.510.060 is handwritten there and typed on p.195, which also prints CODE as 2.013.593). Left out: commune and department rows; pp.144-180 (Tribunal Calificador federation totals by department, used only as a cross-check); p.181-182 cifras repartidoras; p.190-191 candidate counts; p.195 1969 comparison. Boxes are approximate row positions in the grouping-total column.
